The master asks slave 1 to "Write Multiple Registers": write 2 registers starting from 40001

── Data details ──
40001 = 10 (0x000A)
40002 = 257 (0x0101)

── Byte-by-byte ──
00 01        Transaction identifier  Sequence number 0x0001 assigned by the master to this exchange; the response echoes it
00 00        Protocol identifier     0x0000 = standard Modbus protocol
00 0B        Length                  11 more bytes follow (unit identifier + data)
01           Unit identifier         slave address: device 1
10           Function code           0x10 = Write Multiple Registers
00 00        Start address           protocol address 0, PLC address 40001
00 02        Write quantity          write 2 registers
04           Byte count              4 bytes of write data
00 0A 01 01  Write data              every 2 bytes are one register value to write

── Technical details ──
Transport: Modbus TCP (17 bytes total)
Transaction ID: 0x0001
Protocol ID: 0x0000
Length field: 11 (11 bytes actually follow)
Unit ID: 1
Function: 0x10 (Write Multiple Registers)
Start address: 0 (PLC 40001)
Write quantity: 2
Byte count: 4
Data: 00 0A 01 01
PDU: 10 00 00 00 02 04 00 0A 01 01
